description:
An open-source alternative to Claude Cowork, powered by OpenCode

OpenWork is an extensible, open-source “Claude Work” style system for knowledge workers.
It’s a native desktop app that runs OpenCode under the hood, but presents it as a clean, guided workflow:
- pick a workspace
- start a run
- watch progress + plan updates
- approve permissions when needed
- reuse what works (templates + skills)
The goal: make “agentic work” feel like a product, not a terminal.
Agent sessions recover more reliably and provider connections stay consistent
- Conversations now reopen and continue more reliably, with history pages filling correctly and background streaming preserved.
- Mobile chat is easier to use, with steadier submission, scrolling, keyboard, composer, and sidebar behavior.
- Provider connections and cloud workspace startup now handle credentials, readiness, and recovery more reliably.
- Removed custom agents and added clearer linked task references and alpha build information.
Full changelog: https://openworklabs.com/docs/changelog · Compare
Windows installers are signed using Microsoft Artifact Signing.
